channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "How do I use the Anomaly Class Bar?"

item.title: Re: How do I use the Anomaly Class Bar?
item.content:encoded:
Previewing an included component usually won't do much for you because you can't preview changes to the CSS, i.e. the actual formatting and look of the component.

In order to get the look, you need to save the page and it should display.

item.title: Re: How do I use the Anomaly Class Bar?
item.content:encoded: I tried this on the sandbox and it worked completely fine. It doesn't appear in previews I think, so that may be the issue, just try it again and change nothing and hit Save, see if it works.

item.title: Re: How do I use the Anomaly Class Bar?
item.content:encoded: To better help forum-goers assist you, please provide a link to the sandbox on which you are encountering the error.
